# --- FF reproduction patch (stage f10_models, CHANGES.md #1): edit two helper modules written by the cell above BEFORE they
# --- are imported. (a) ImageBind: Meta's link is dead since 12/11/2026 -> the same file (sha256 d6f6c22b...2157) on a pinned
# --- Hugging Face mirror (the dead URL is spelled in two parts so that a text-level URL patch cannot alter this edit).
# --- (b) Hugging Face revisions pinned (the runs of 27-28/09/2026 resolved "main").
def _ff_edit(path, edits):
    t = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for _old, _new in edits:
        assert t.count(_old) == 1, f"FF patch: {path}: {_old[:70]!r} found {t.count(_old)} times"
        t = t.replace(_old, _new)
    Path(path).write_text(t, encoding="utf-8")

    ('URL = "https://dl.fbaipublicfiles' + '.com/imagebind/imagebind_huge.pth"',

# --- FF dev-exclusion (CHANGES.md #2): index ONLY the organiser train list. Original line:
# ---     S = M.v4_index(SCAN, WORKDIR / "raw")
# --- v4_index needs the four dev lists too and, for zipped data, unpacks dev_set.zip. Same train rows and order as there:
# --- flag_extract.resolve_split on train_English.txt (what flag_extract.index_splits does for "train").
_ff_tr = [p for p in SCAN["files"].get("train_English.txt", []) if M._has_media(p, 2, 3)]
if _ff_tr:
    _ff_root = _ff_tr[0].parent
else:
    import zipfile as _ff_zip
    _ff_root = WORKDIR / "raw"
    _ff_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    _ff_zips = [p for n, ps in SCAN["files"].items() if n.lower().startswith("train_set") and n.lower().endswith(".zip") for p in ps]
    assert _ff_zips, "no v4 train media under the inputs: attach the raw dataset (train_set.zip)"
    for _zp in _ff_zips:
        if not (_ff_root / f".{_zp.stem}.done").exists():
            X.log("extracting", _zp.name)
            with _ff_zip.ZipFile(_zp) as _z:
                _z.extractall(_ff_root)
            (_ff_root / f".{_zp.stem}.done").touch()
S = {"train": X.resolve_split(_ff_root, "train_English.txt", 2, 3)}
for _k, _v in S.items():
    _v["dur"] = np.array([X.sf.info(str(_v["root"] / p)).duration for p in _v["wav"]], dtype=np.float32)
    X.log(f"{_k:20s} {len(_v['wav']):5d} rows | dur median {np.median(_v['dur']):.1f}s max {_v['dur'].max():.1f}s")

patches.new:
# FF environment patch (CHANGES.md #4): one pip call per package, the team's own fix of 29/10 - 2/11/2026 (BEST/v1977/README.md
    # §6): openai CLIP's setup.py needs pkg_resources, missing on the current Kaggle image, and a failed build in this shared call also
    # drops insightface / ImageBind. CLIP then comes from a git clone at d50d76d with that one import line patched (FaRL needs `clip`).
    !pip -q install --no-deps "insightface==2.0" "git+https://github.com/facebookresearch/ImageBind" 2>&1 | tail -2
    !pip -q install --no-deps "git+https://github.com/openai/CLIP.git" 2>&1 | tail -2
    try:
        import clip
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        import subprocess
        _oc = Path("/tmp/openai_clip")
        if not (_oc / "clip").exists():
            subprocess.run(["git", "clone", "-q", "https://github.com/openai/CLIP.git", str(_oc)], check=True)
            subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(_oc), "checkout", "-q", "d50d76daa670286dd6cacf3bcd80b5e4823fc8e1"], check=True)
            _f = _oc / "clip/clip.py"
            _f.write_text(_f.read_text().replace("from pkg_resources import packaging", "import packaging, packaging.version"))
        sys.path.insert(0, str(_oc))
        import clip
patches.why: the shared pip call fails on the current Kaggle image (openai CLIP build); split into one call per package + CLIP fallback clone (the team's own fix, BEST/v1977/README.md §6)
patches.effect: none expected (same packages); the CLIP fallback is pinned at d50d76d, the commit used by the team's other notebooks; the original pip line resolved an unpinned openai/CLIP HEAD on 27-28/09/2026, not verified to be d50d76d
